name: Raeed & Sons
old_description: Mon–Thu 10am–6pm · Fri 12–6pm · Walk-ins welcome at 1105 S 12th St
about:
Raeed & Sons opened its doors in May 2013 at 1105 South 12th Street in Bismarck, North Dakota. The shop is family‑owned and operated by Raeed Douri, who brought over thirty years of electronics experience to the venture. He started the business with a simple mission: give every broken device a fair shot and treat every customer like family.

The shop provides component‑level repair for a wide range of electronics. Services include screen, battery, and charge‑port replacement on smartphones and tablets; hardware upgrades, custom builds, virus removal, and full diagnostics on Windows and Mac computers; and board‑level work on engine control units, transmission modules, power supplies, and industrial PCBs — covering capacitor replacement, IC reflow, and trace repair. Free diagnostics are standard, and most repairs are completed in under an hour. The operation runs as a walk‑in service center with no appointment needed.

Customers span individual consumers with damaged phones or laptops, automotive shops needing ECU or module repair, and industrial clients with faulty control boards or power supplies. The shop’s expertise in component‑level fixes often saves customers the cost of full unit replacement, a value highlighted by automotive and industrial referrals.

Raeed & Sons emphasizes personal attention, transparent pricing, and a no‑pressure approach. The company cites its A+ Better Business Bureau rating, 100% recommendation rate on Facebook, and a track record of thousands of repairs as evidence of its commitment to sending every customer home happier than they arrived.

name: Rago Fabrication
old_description: 2010-2024 5th Gen Toyota 4Runner Molle Storage Panel System | Pair
about:
Rago Fabrication operates from Chandler, Arizona, where it designs and builds aftermarket overlanding and off-road accessories. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders in the available sources.

The product line centers on vehicle-specific storage and mounting systems: Molle panels and shelves, roof racks and crossbars, front and rear bumpers, light brackets, skid plates and rock sliders, on-board air systems, battery and electrical components, bed racks and rail systems, and suspension parts. These items are developed for a wide range of platforms including Toyota 4Runner, Tacoma, Tundra, Land Cruiser and Sequoia; Lexus GX models; Subaru Forester, Crosstrek and Outback; the Ineos Grenadier; Rivian R1T; Ford Bronco; Chevrolet Colorado and GMC Canyon; Jeep Gladiator; and Nissan Frontier and Xterra. In addition to its own fabricated parts, Rago stocks lighting and recovery gear from brands such as Rigid Industries, Baja Designs, KC HiLites, Nacho Offroad Lighting and DV8 Elite Series.

Primary customers are overlanding enthusiasts, off-road vehicle owners and commercial upfitters who purchase directly through the company's e-commerce site or through a network of authorized dealers. The catalog is organized by vehicle generation, allowing buyers to select parts guaranteed to fit specific model years.

Rago states that its products represent the "gold standard of fit, finish, and attention to detail" and are "designed tough" to withstand demanding use. The company recently introduced permanent price reductions on core items such as Molle panels, ditch brackets and cross bars in response to customer feedback.

name: Rainier Woodworking Co
old_description: We will create the right solution from your vision, or we can surprise you with a finished product that you wont be disappointed with.
about:
Rainier Woodworking Co operates from Tacoma, Washington, where it has served the Greater Puget Sound region for many years. The company focuses on producing heirloom-quality cabinetry using locally sourced wood, emphasizing respect for the material and long-lasting craftsmanship.

The shop manufactures a full line of cabinetry, offering custom design services that translate client visions into finished pieces. Production includes woodworking, finishing, and assembly, with a proprietary project-tracking app (RW CabTracker) available on the Apple App Store to keep customers informed throughout the process.

Rainier’s cabinetry is distributed exclusively through professional designers and established kitchen and bath dealers along the West Coast. This channel-focused approach means the company works closely with design professionals and showroom partners rather than selling direct to end users.

The business stresses fair pricing and adherence to client budgets and timelines, positioning its locally made, wood-centric products as a durable alternative to mass-market options. A stated commitment to tree stewardship underpins the material selection and build quality.

name: Ramco AutomotiveThe Sensor Specialist
old_description: Currently over 50 countries qualify for express international shipping.
about:
Ramco Automotive, founded in 2007 and centrally located in Miami, Florida, was established by founders drawing on 40 years of industry experience. The company began as an independent manufacturer and distributor of electrical and electronic replacement parts for motor vehicles, targeting the automotive aftermarket.

The company manufactures a full line of sensors and vehicle parts under the RAMCO brand, including crankshaft position sensors, idle air control valves, camshaft position sensors, fuel pressure regulators, coolant temperature sensors, ignition control modules, ignition coils, and knock detonation sensors. It also distributes products from other aftermarket manufacturers through an online platform that supports ACES and PIES data standards, enabling dynamic catalog management and cross-referencing capabilities.

Ramco serves distributors and retailers across the automotive aftermarket, with a growing focus on original equipment and original equipment service channels. Its customer base spans the United States, Latin America, Europe, and the Middle East, supported by express international shipping to over 50 countries.

The company emphasizes honesty, quality guaranteed, reliability, and timeliness in order delivery as core values.

name: Ramco Solutions
old_description: Let us help you solve your food conveyance issues. From packaging conveyors, meat conveyors, cook plant conveyors and much more.
about:
Ramco Solutions, based in Laurel, Delaware, traces its roots to 1995 when Brian Ramey and a partner founded Planned Poultry Renovations after Ramey's engineering roles at Perdue Farms and Townsend’s. The current company emerged as a 21st‑century evolution of that business, now led by Ramey alongside his son Kolby and daughter Hali.

The company designs, fabricates, and installs food‑grade conveyance systems, mezzanines, maintenance platforms, and custom sheet‑metal components. Its shop runs a 4 kW fiber laser (cutting up to 1" mild steel, 0.75" stainless and aluminum), a 180‑ton press brake, a 110‑ton iron worker, a 4‑roll plate roll, a CNC router for plastics, a wet saw, and a 10'×20' sandblast booth. Capabilities also include TIG/MIG/stick welding, 3D laser scanning, 3D CAD modeling, Ramcoat non‑slip coating application, and 3D printing in polycarbonate, carbon‑fiber blends, and Ultem.

Ramco serves food‑processing plants, poultry operations, food‑and‑beverage manufacturers, and food‑service contractors. Project examples include a debone renovation, rechiller roof‑access stairs, a wing cyclone platform, and tray‑pack stairs. The firm also supplies parts and components to other builders of food‑grade conveyors and machinery.

The company’s stated mission is to deliver innovative design solutions through plug‑and‑play modular conveyor models, standardized parts, and an easy quoting process. Its vision emphasizes new equipment development via research and development, while its values highlight pioneering, ownership, boldness, adaptability, family, faith, safety, and solving problems today.

name: Ramtel Corporation
old_description: Ramtel specializes in Custom Silk Screened phone panels, individualized to your needs
about:
Ramtel Corporation, based in Johnston, Rhode Island, traces its origins to 1983 when the company (then called Ramtech) was formed following the divestiture of the telephone industry. The venture began as a collaboration with an Ivy League university in New England to address the vulnerability of standard receiver phones to vandalism.

Today Ramtel manufactures a range of security communication devices, including custom silk‑screened phone panels, hands‑free emergency phones, elevator phones, and VoIP endpoints. Production encompasses silk screening on anodized aluminum, fabrication of non‑rusting stainless‑steel columns and enclosures, electronics assembly with conformal coating, and weather‑ and vandal‑resistant finishing. All assembly and testing occur in‑house at the Rhode Island facility, with multiple quality‑assurance checkpoints throughout the build process.

The product line serves security integrators, campus safety departments, K‑12 school districts, commercial property managers, and elevator contractors. Installations include area‑of‑refuge stations, courtyard emergency columns, elevator cab communication, and campus‑wide alert systems compatible with platforms such as Cisco CUCM, Asterisk, and Avaya IP Office.

Ramtel distinguishes itself as the only U.S. manufacturer that fabricates stainless‑steel columns in‑house and offers fully customized silk‑screened panels for each project. The company emphasizes made‑in‑USA production, a service‑first approach, and a history of introducing new features — such as piezo switches, ADA‑compliant indicator lights, and remote diagnostics — ahead of the market.

name: Ray's Western Wear & Saddlery
old_description: Exceptional fit, built-in stretch, and dependable durability.
about:
Ray's Western Wear & Saddlery operates in Oacoma, South Dakota, a location chosen in 1996 for its visibility on Interstate 90. The business traces its roots to April 1957, when Ray Steckelberg purchased a men's clothing store in nearby Chamberlain and began selling horse tack from the basement. The founder's youngest son, Duane, and his wife Sheryl joined the operation in 1974, and the store transitioned fully to western wear and tack by 1970. Today, the company remains family-owned, now led by fourth-generation great-granddaughter Brooke and her husband Kaiden, continuing a legacy of more than 65 years.

The store functions as a retail destination branded as "South Dakota's Cowboy Store." It carries a large selection of boots, western apparel, denim, and horse tack, along with seasonal western trends. Brands such as Wrangler and collaborative lines like Lainey Wilson x Wrangler are featured. The business emphasizes fit and durability, offering tack fitting services under the slogan "We Fit The Horse Too!" and assisting customers with boot selection. No manufacturing takes place on site; the focus is on curated retail and personalized fitting.

Customers include western lifestyle consumers, horse owners, ranchers, rodeo participants, and travelers pulling horse trailers along I-90. The store serves both local residents and tourists seeking authentic western gear, positioning itself as a stop for those needing reliable apparel and equipment for work or recreation.

The company's stated differentiation rests on its deep family heritage, its claim to the region's largest boot selection, and its specialized tack fitting service. These elements, combined with a location designed to capture interstate traffic, form the core of its market appeal.

name: Ready Made Plastic Trays
old_description: Businesses have trusted our genuine, American-made trays since 1990.
about:
Ready Made Plastic Trays was founded in 1990 in Meridian, Idaho, and has operated as a domestic manufacturer of thermoformed plastic trays for over three decades. The company emphasizes American-made production and domestically sourced materials traceable to their original manufacturers.

The company produces stock and custom thermoformed trays for packaging and storage, offering pocket shapes including square, round, and rectangular configurations with a maximum depth of two inches. An on-site CNC tooling shop enables custom fixture design and re-tooling for specific client requirements. Standard materials include High Impact Polystyrene (HIPS), with food-grade, medical-grade, and anti-static variants available.

Ready Made serves industries such as aerospace, automotive, dental, electronics, firearms, food and beverage, machining, manufacturing, medical, and optical. Customers range from medical device manufacturers and mechanical shops to aerospace suppliers and food processors, as well as distributors and individual buyers seeking protective packaging for shipping delicate or complex components.

The company positions itself as a service-first partner, highlighting rapid production, no-nonsense ordering, free samples, volume discounts, and direct access to a real person for support. Its ISO 9001:2015 certification underpins a commitment to meeting customer and supplier needs while maintaining inventory levels for quick turnaround.

name: Real Steel Manufacturing
old_description: We are an AWS certified welding facility, providing domestic and international service.
about:
Real Steel Manufacturing operates from Muskegon Heights, Michigan, as an AWS-certified welding facility serving both domestic and international customers. The company emphasizes welding and fabrication services performed to high quality standards.

Its capabilities span fabrication and welding, aluminum fabrication and welding, in-house machining of components and weldments, assembly, coating and finishing, media blasting, CNC laser and plasma cutting of sheet and plate, CNC sheet bending and plate bump-forming, post-weld heat treatment, and fixture design. The shop offers turn-key supply from raw material to finished, assembled product, handling small to medium welded assemblies that can ship in as little as one week, as well as large complex assemblies with tight tolerances and critical lead times.

The company's project history includes process vessels ranging from 14 ft by 48 in diameter to 8 ft by 24 in diameter with complex internal fixtures, and it has served clients such as Van Pelt Industries. Specific industry sectors are not detailed on the website.

Real Steel highlights speed and budget adherence as key differentiators, promoting fast turnaround and a single-source approach from material procurement through final coating.

name: Real Wood Furniture
old_description: The Home of Real Wood Furniture: Serving the Metro DC Area: Northern Virginia - NOVA - Maryland - Washington, DC - District of Columbia
about:
Real Wood Furniture operates from Chantilly, Virginia, serving the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area including Northern Virginia and Maryland. The company presents itself as a furniture store offering a range of solid-wood pieces for residential and home-office settings.

The business supplies factory-finished, finished-to-order, and unfinished furniture across categories that span living room, bedroom, dining room, entertainment, home office, wall units, library, home theater, and youth collections. It works in pine, maple, oak, cherry, alder, reclaimed lumber, and parawood, and offers styles such as Shaker, modern, contemporary, traditional, mission, Amish, and barn wood. Both standard and build-to-order configurations are available, with an emphasis on real-wood construction and no particle board.

Customers include homeowners and small businesses throughout the Metro DC region looking for solid-wood furnishings. The company positions its offering as a value proposition for those seeking durable, customizable pieces without composite materials.

Real Wood Furniture highlights its material transparency — no particle board — and the flexibility of finished-to-order and unfinished options as key differentiators, allowing buyers to match specific aesthetics or apply their own finishes.
